quotes.text: Our word champion comes from campus, the field; … 'Champion is he, properly, who fights in the field; i.e., in camps.' A man well skilled in arms, strong, brave, and patriotic. But is this the meaning of the original … ish habbenayim, a middle man, the man between two; that is, as here, the man who undertakes to settle the disputes between two armies or nations. So our ancient champions settled disputes between contending parties by what was termed camp fight; hence the campio or champion.
